mission: Prove that continuous environmental fields plus resource competition, mutation, dispersal and history can generate reusable plant species and population patterns without hardcoded biome placement.

nearest_checkpoint.name: Environmental Causality Baseline
nearest_checkpoint.goal: Prove deterministic continuous environment truth and a causal resource/cost response of one fixed plant genome before introducing evolution.

steps.name: Environment Contracts + Deterministic Fixture
steps.output: Headless EXP-V0 with stable environment queries, control samples and environment hash.

steps.name: Single-Plant Resource Model
steps.output: Headless EXP-V1 with explicit resource income, costs, bounded biomass and limiting-factor evidence.

steps.name: Diagnostic Visual Lab + Controlled Trait Probes
steps.output: Presentation-only heatmap lab and controlled sensitivity probes sharing the accepted S1/S2 truth model.

steps.name: Determinism, Sensitivity and Failure Classification
steps.output: Replay acceptance runner, sensitivity evidence and explicit failure matrix.

steps.name: P1A Acceptance + Evolution Decision
steps.output: ACCEPTED or classified FAIL decision and handoff to ECO.P1B Local Adaptation Proof.

acceptance_gate: environment query is deterministic and seam-safe
environment truth is independent from camera LOD and presentation
one fixed genome produces favourable marginal and unsustainable zones
resource and cost breakdown explains local outcome
at least one real trait trade-off is demonstrated
same seed and revision produce identical environment and simulation hashes
controlled trait probes move niches in explainable directions
visual and headless evidence share one truth model
nearest_checkpoint.after_pass: ECO.P1B Local Adaptation Proof using mutation and selection from one ancestor
nearest_checkpoint.after_fail: Do not add evolution; classify and repair ENVIRONMENT_MODEL, RESOURCE_MODEL, TRADEOFF_MODEL, NUMERICAL_STABILITY, DIAGNOSTIC_GAP or PERFORMANCE_MODEL.

waves.name: Plant Adaptation Proof
waves.goal: Prove deterministic environment response, local adaptation and coexistence of multiple strategies.
gate: environment queries are deterministic and seam-safe
mutation creates regionally distinct trait distributions
at least three persistent strategies coexist on one heterogeneous fixture
same seed produces identical result hash
different seeds preserve specialization as a phenomenon

waves.name: Ecological History Proof
waves.goal: Prove succession, disturbance memory, dispersal-limited ranges and lineage divergence.
gate: succession emerges without scripted succession states
disturbance history remains visible in population composition
suitable habitat does not create species without migration
at least one stable lineage split preserves common ancestry

waves.name: Portable Ecology Proof
waves.goal: Convert expensive evolution results into reusable catalog and representation-safe runtime candidates.
gate: new fixtures can be populated without replaying long evolution
phenotype presentation does not affect ecology hash
population representation transitions conserve ecological state
player disturbance feeds generic ecological rules rather than scripted biome replacement

runtime_promotion_requirements: ECO.P3 SpeciesCatalog bake proven before production integration
PC0 branch registration from then-current main
harness checkpoint permits runtime frontier creation
authority and persistence design reviewed separately
